transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net, my name's Chloe. How can I help you?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hi Chloe. I'd like to set up parental controls on the home wifi, I've got two kids and I'm not sure where to start.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Of course. So you'd like parental controls on your home wifi for your two children, and you're not sure how to set them up. Is that right?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That's right.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Before we start, can you confirm the address on the account for me?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: 48 Mill Road, Bristol, BS3 1QT.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you, Yasmin. Which devices do the kids use, tablets, phones, a games console?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Two tablets and an Xbox.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And how old are they? It helps me suggest the right filter level.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Seven and eleven.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Do you want to block content only, or also set times when the wifi switches off for them?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Both, if that's possible. Off at eight on school nights.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Absolutely. Do you have the S-Net app on your phone?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, I do.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Great. Open it and tap on Home Network, then Family. Can you see that?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, Family is there.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Tap add profile, call it Kids, and choose the two tablets and the Xbox from the device list.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, done. It's asking for a filter level.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Choose Junior for now, you can change it later. Then tap Schedule, and set off at eight p.m., Sunday to Thursday.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Done. It says the profile is active.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect. Could you try opening a website on one of the tablets that should be blocked, just to check?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It says this site is blocked by your family settings. Brilliant.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Great, so the controls and the bedtime schedule are working. Is there anything else you'd like to set up while we're here?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, that's everything. Thanks Chloe.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You're welcome, Yasmin. Thank you for choosing S-Net, and have a lovely evening.
